text:
RECOMMENDATION: DON'T RAISE IT
LIKELIHOOD: 0

Both you and the successful candidate are women, so sex was not a deciding factor in choosing her over you. An all-female selection panel choosing one female applicant over another offers no factual or legal basis for a claim of sex discrimination. Bringing up the panel's gender composition would harm your professional credibility.

Instead, focus on objective qualifications and procedural fairness. You hold a master's degree in educational leadership and five years of administrative experience. Send a polite follow-up regarding your requested written feedback, framing your questions strictly around the selection criteria, interview evaluations, and school leadership competencies rather than demographics.
